_about: Gold benchmark for the s1-ready heuristic schema inferencer. Each case: a use-case sentence and the expected schema. 'types' is the multiset of question types expected (order-insensitive). 'options' maps a 0-based question index to the exact expected option set when the use case states options explicitly; absent = not checked. Representative of typical decision use cases across domains and phrasings.
